subject: bryn-eriksson
label: What she actually drew
from: A small cosy cabin near the lake, big enough for her and Torie
note: That was the whole ambition of the woman who ended up with two hundred acres, three Havens and seventy-two daughters. One warm building, two people, water out the window — at the back of the property, where THE BACKYARD LAKE still is. She walks past the site of the house she never built every single day, and it is a beach now.
